newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell Thomson-CSF in private placement.
newsitem.headline: France to sell Thomson-CSF in private placement.

text.p: The French government plans to privatise defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF through a private placement with the aim of forming a big defence grouping, the finance, industry and defence ministries said on Wednesday.
The sale will include a list of terms and conditions which will be submitted soon to the independent Privatisation Commission, the ministries said in a joint statement.

The ministries said the government was seeking through the privatisation to bring together many industrial capabilities around Thomson in the context of a restructuring of the European defence industry.
"...It is open to the participation of French and European industrial players in this sector in the construction, in stages, around Thomson-CSF, of a big defence electronics grouping," it said.
The government is relaunching the privatisation of Thomson-CSF, part of the Thomson SA group, after having cancelled its previous plan to sell the entire group in one block in December.
The government had previously expressed a preference for a bid for Lagardere for the Thomson group but the Privatisation Commission objected to the terms of the sale.
